originalTitle: CoreWeave’s stock pops — even as Nvidia talks up a ‘disciplined’ approach to financing
summary: Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress said neoclouds are “increasingly important,” but added the company will take “a very strong look” at the customers it helps with financing.
content: Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress said neoclouds are “increasingly important,” but added the company will take “a very strong look” at the customers it helps with financing.
chineseTitle: CoreWeave 的股价上涨——尽管 Nvidia 谈论的是“严格的”融资方式
